notes:
# v1.4.15 - reader toolbar stays put, system bars hide while reading

- Fixed: tapping the reader now brings the reading bar back every time. In the
  App Store glass themes the bar had lost its fixed position and scrolled away
  with the chapter, so the tap toggled something that was no longer on screen.
- Fixed: the floating tab bar no longer leaves a sliver of itself visible at the
  bottom of the reading screen.
- Fixed: Android now hides the status and navigation bars properly while
  reading, so the gesture pill no longer sits over the page. The bars come back
  the moment you leave the reader.
- Note: the system-bar fix is native, so it ships with the next APK. Everything
  else arrives over the air.
